checks.label: The gear ratio is the input's angular speed ÷ the output's: 1450 ÷ 290 = 5 for the opening pair, and 1450 ÷ 96.7 = 15 with the second pair
A belt that does not slip moves at the speed of both pulley rims: 6.1 m/s round the 80 mm pulley at 151.8 rad/s and round the 400 mm pulley at 30.4 rad/s
Rotational power needs the speed in rad/s: 11 kW at 151.8 rad/s is 72.4 N m, and the drum's 4000 W at 25.13 rad/s is 159 N m, where 4000 ÷ 240 would give 16.7
Speed reduced, torque increased, and the power out smaller than the power in: torque × speed out is the power out at every tooth count, and below 100% it is under 11 kW
The opening pair: 5 : 1 gives 290 rev/min and, at 95%, 344 N m and 10.45 kW with 550 W lost; the teeth meet at 6.1 m/s and push with 1811 N, giving 362 N m with no loss
Two pairs: 5 × 3 = 15 gives 96.7 rev/min, 9.93 kW (about 90%) and 981 N m at 95% each, and the last shaft turns the same way as the motor
Equal teeth pass the speed and torque through less the loss; a wheel smaller than the pinion speeds the pump shaft up and cuts its torque
Both gears' teeth move at the same speed at the mesh: the drawn wheel turns by the pinion's teeth ÷ its own, at every tooth count
Every puzzle answer is worked from its rule: 483 rev/min, 60 N m, 14.4 kW, 60 rev/min, 580 rev/min and 159 N m, with the wrong picks 4350, 6.7, 60 kW, 144, 360, 3625, 39.8 and 16.7
Misalignment brings heat to couplings and bearings: the hot pump with parallel shafts 0.5 mm apart has parallel misalignment
Each puzzle offers three answers and accepts only its right one; every wrong answer has its own hint and its working drawn in red, and nothing is marked before Check
Every demonstration ends within 4 s of its screen opening, and every answer is drawn within 2.5 s of Check
Every screen that shows an idea says it in 90 words or fewer
